QUICK DRAW CROAK'S HIDEOUT · EVERY UNIT, EVERY DIFFICULTY

What Quick Draw Croak, his son, the posse, the ladies, the rattlesnake and the stampede do to your men on EASY, MEDIUM, HARD and MEGA, with every body's HP and head-count · read out of the live game v32.45 on Nov 14, 2026 14:06 EST · every damage number checked on the game's own machines (Chrome 125/125 · WebKit 125/125) · for Raziya

The one thing to know: every hit in the hideout is a bar hit (the King Rex page's word): it takes a share of a man's health bar, not a fixed HP. Quick Draw Croak's and his son's hits grow with difficulty: × 1 · 1.1 · 1.1 · 1.2 (EASY · MEDIUM · HARD · MEGA). On MEGA (CARD-MKC) everything on his side also hits twice as hard and has six times the bar, so his strong shot is 7.2 bar hits against 4 on EASY. The bandits, sharpshooters, ladies and rattlesnake hit the same on EASY, MEDIUM and HARD. The stampede and the ladies' fire never change. The snake's swallow is built to KO (it carries his whole bar left + 1, × 2 on MEGA), but since the damper it lands at 50 % like every hit: on MEDIUM and HARD a fresh man stands it, and 3 or 4 in a row KO a stock man; on MEGA it still empties a full bar, so a rifleman falls to one and anyone else stands on 15 % of his bar (THE FLOOR since v31.00) and falls to the next.
THE BOSS LAB fights Quick Draw Croak with its stock army: Sarge with the saber, the jeep, the plane and 9 men (rifleman, M. gunner, bazooka, mortar, medic, flame, sweeper, radio man, grenadier), at level 30 on EASY, 33 on MEDIUM, 37 on HARD and 40 on MEGA (MEGA adds the tank and leaves the grenadier home). At the lab's levels 30, 33 and 37 the stock army reads the same HP and bar, so EASY, MEDIUM and HARD meet the same men (not every rank between: the stock Sarge's saber reads 29 HP at ranks 38 and 39 against 28 at 30–37; the Claymore Sarge and the heroes climb a little); MEGA's level-40 men are one step tougher. Since Nov 13 (CARD-BLI) the lab's own HARD fight is Isaac's army instead, at commander level 100 (rifleman 25, M. gunner 30, bazooka 20, mortar 22, medic 0, radio man 1; Sarge with the sniper rifle); this page keeps the default ladder's level-37 roster in its HARD columns so the tiers compare, and the HARD bodies are the lab's, born at level 100. The lab fields no hero; the hero rows below show one in command at the same level.

How a hit is counted

Your men carry HP (the number on their unit sheet) and a health bar cut into a few bar hits: 5 to 7 for a level-30 man, 7 to 9 at rank 100, 11 for the saber Sarge and 22 with the Claymore, 43 to 272 for a hero. A man is KO'd when the bar hits he has taken fill his bar.

  • THE DAMPER (since v29.17): every hit an enemy lands on your men, Sarge and the heroes in the campaign and the boss fights lands at 50 % of the bar hits it carries (the game takes 50 % off on every tier, read on every tier of this fight and measured in its lab fight); every survive, first-survive and HP number on this page counts it.
  • THE FLOOR (since v31.00, CARD-RZB, on every tier here): no single hit fells a man other than a rifleman from a full bar. The hit that would leaves him on 15 % of his bar and the next hit that reaches him fells him, so he needs at least 2 hits from a full bar (measured on every tier: his shot on a rank-0 medic, whose bar of 2 it would empty, left him on 15 % and the next shot felled him; a rank-0 rifleman keeps no floor, and on MEGA fell to one shot). Sarge and the heroes count as men other than riflemen.
  • THE CAP (since v31.00): one blow reaches at most 3 · 4 · 4 · 5 men (EASY · MEDIUM · HARD · MEGA); a blow is one spot inside 0.75 s, so his storm's volleys land on that many of the men in his cone and the rest are untouched (measured: 3 of 5 · 4 of 6 · 4 of 6 · 5 of 7). The stampede and the ladies' fire are not blows.
  • NO INSTANT KO (since v29.70, CARD-BDC2): a blow that would KO outright takes 31.5 HP (40.5 on MEGA) instead. Nothing in the hideout is such a blow (measured: the price never ran here).
  • Every attack in the hideout carries a number of bar hits (the tables below). Since v28.65 a man takes 90 % + 10 % × bar ÷ HP of what lands: 0.933 for a level-30 rifleman, 0.908 for a flame. A hero takes all of what lands.
  • In HP, one bar hit lands as that man's HP ÷ his bar × 50 % (the damper) × his share: 1.4 HP of a level-30 rifleman's 18, 5.82 of a flame's 77. The HP figures on this page are that conversion.
  • A man who takes no hit for 4 s mends. Saves still roll on every hit: a jetting or dragged man cannot be touched, the pet shield, the deflect dome, Sarge's and the Commander's absorbs, the saber's block (one in two from rank 20) and the dodges. The snake's swallow is built to KO (it carries his whole bar left + 1, × 2 on MEGA), but since the damper it lands at 50 % like every hit: on MEDIUM and HARD a fresh man stands it, and 3 or 4 in a row KO a stock man (measured: a fresh level-33 flame on MEDIUM took 3.2 of his 6 bar hits and stood); on MEGA it still empties a full bar, so a rifleman falls to one and anyone else stands on 15 % of his bar (THE FLOOR since v31.00) and falls to the next (measured: a fresh level-40 flame on MEGA).

Quick Draw Croak

moveEASYMEDIUMHARDMEGAhow it works
STRONG SHOT4 bar hits4.4 bar hits4.4 bar hits7.2 bar hitsHis two pistols, one man at a time: the nearest man within 400 px, every 1.2 to 2.4 s (random), the first 2 s after he walks on (measured: 2.0 s on every tier). 2 bar hits × 2 · 2 · 2 · 1.5 since v31.00 (EASY · MEDIUM · HARD · MEGA, his single shot, CARD-RZB) × the tier's damage, × 2 more on MEGA.
THE STORM9 bar hits (1.125 × 8) · 210 px9.9 bar hits (1.238 × 8) · 210 px9.9 bar hits (1.238 × 8) · 294 px21.6 bar hits (2.7 × 8) · 420 pxHis barrage: a wall clock of 10 s on every tier (the first one ready at 7 s; measured 7.8 to 9.4 s), and it fires only when a man stands in his cone (±0.62 rad, the reach above). He crouches 0.55 s (the tell), then 8 volleys 0.2 s apart, right hand, left hand, × 3 at the door since v31.95 (THE MINIONS SOAK). Each volley lands on the men in the cone, at most 3 · 4 · 4 · 5 of them since v31.00 (one blow's reach, CARD-RZB; measured: his storm on that many + 2 men landed on that many, every volley). Run out of the cone and the rest miss. Since v31.00 the frame he plants it his son's storm comes off its clock and every lady lobs a fire patch onto the same men.
THE HUNTpresses to 170 pxpresses to 170 pxpresses to 170 pxpresses to 170 pxTwo legs in three he walks at the nearest man at 150 px/s and stops 170 px from him (inside his own storm); the third leg wanders where he stands at 125 px/s. Never west of x 300 (the toy box sits at x 130, a leak 64 px round it).
COVERevery 14 % of his barevery 14 % of his barevery 14 % of his barevery 14 % of his barEach time he loses 14 % of his bar he rolls: 1 in 3 he runs (220 px/s) behind the crates and ducks 2.2 s (nobody can target him there), 2 in 3 he shrugs and keeps pressing. The son rolls every 34 % of his.
THE BREAK6 gates7 gates7 gates8 gatesEach time his bar crosses a gate (85 %, 75 %, 60 %, 50 %, 40 %, 30 %, 20 %) he barks, bolts for cover at 320 px/s and that gate's wave walks on (the wave sheets below).
THE JEEP DODGE50 %65 %80 %90 %A jeep rushing at him on his row from within 300 px: he leaps a lane (150 px) after a 0.25 s tell, at these odds, then 4 s before the next dodge.
HIS BAR (one commander)2,252 · son 3153,003 · son 4204,504 · son 6315,532 · son 1,164The designers' time-to-kill chart (CARD-RXT) sets his bar for one commander on EASY · MEDIUM · HARD (2,252 · 3,003 · 4,504) and the player-damage-threshold pass (CARD-PDT) sets MEGA's (5,535 in its table): the game writes each tier's wave row with the multiplier that lands it over his 160 HP base (× 14.075 · 18.7688 · 28.15 · 5.7656), rounded to the HP; on MEGA the MEGA hideout rules' (CARD-MKC) × 6 comes after that rounding, so the bar born is 5,532, 3 HP under the table. Before the chart (v29.23) the bar was the base × the tier's dial (1 · 1.2 · 1.5 · 2.25; MEGA × 1.2 more, then × 6): 160 · 192 · 240 · 2,592. The son's row rides the same multipliers over his 32 (× 9.8525 · 13.1381 · 19.705 · 6.0539): 315 · 420 · 631 · 1,164 (was 22 · 27 · 34 · 546); on MEGA the brood's four keep the dial's own arithmetic and are born at 546 each. How this was read and checked

The client v32.45 (index.html md5 3a46a5281956aeaf75ac23e3b689a4ba, the live client, pinned once for the read and every proof on both engines) was opened headless and read with the game's own functions: every table, every tier's wave sheet and bars, the lab's stock army on each tier, every man's bar and HP at every rank. Then each damage number was measured on the real machines in a BOSS LAB fight on every tier: every attacker was born through its own wave row (so the tier's and MEGA's stamps were the game's own), stood near men at that tier's lab level and left to its own brain until it hit. Quick Draw Croak's strong shot and storm, Little Quick Draw Croak's (and on MEGA a son of the brood's) shot and storm, a bandit's, a sharpshooter's and a lady's round on riflemen, M. gunners, flames and medics, the ladies' fire, the rattlesnake's lunge and swallow, the stampede (and the stun it leaves), and every body's bar as born; on every tier the damper's share the lab fight takes off, and on every landed hit the damper's one seat; since v31.00 CARD-RZB's and CARD-BDC2's cells where each lab fight stands, his single shot on a rank-0 medic and a rank-0 rifleman (THE FLOOR), his storm on as many men as one blow reaches + 2 (THE CAP), and the KO price's own count (it never ran). Chrome 125/125 · WebKit 125/125 checks passed with zero page errors; the page rebuilt every one of the 506 measured hits from the read and they all agree; the two engines read every number the same.
